Compute circular topography data

Source: R/directional-cylindrical.R
circular_topography_data.Rd

Compute circular topography data

Usage

circular_topography_data(theta, x, conditional = TRUE, ...)

Arguments

theta

Angles in radians.

x

Real-valued response.

conditional

If TRUE, rows are normalized to estimate f(x | theta).

...

Additional arguments passed to estimate_cyl_density().

Value

A data frame with columns theta, x and density.

See also

Other cylindrical dependence helpers: estimate_cyl_density(), phase_loom_data(), stat_orbit_data()

Examples

dat <- simulate_cylindrical(n = 80, seed = 1)
circular_topography_data(dat$theta, dat$x, n_theta = 24, n_x = 30)
